description: Why: check_ingest requires a Date: header per RFC 1036 §2.1 mandatory header validation. What: build_rotation_article in cli/key_rotate.rs constructs the key-rotation article with From, Message-ID, Newsgroups, Subject, and X-Stoa-Key-Rotation headers but no Date: header. Every key-rotation article submitted via IHAVE will therefore be rejected with 437 (missing mandatory header) before reaching storage. Key rotation is silently broken.
title: build_rotation_article missing Date: header
